title: Resume root data
description: data/resume.yaml — top-level resume fields exposed to templates as hugo.Data.resume.*

name.description: Full name, shown as the page <h1>.

position.description: Job title / tagline shown under the name.

summary.description: Markdown supported (rendered with markdownify). Use a YAML block scalar (|) with a trailing backslash on each line to keep paragraphs separate without extra blank lines.

end.description: End date, unquoted YYYY-MM-DD. Omit or use ~ if ongoing.
